subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing
subdomain.capability: Continuous high-throughput ingestion of raw 1Hz time-series sensor payloads (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry) from IoT edge devices, bike computers and smart wearables; enforces Sensor Metric Boundaries, reconciles out-of-order backfills and buffers windowed streams for streaming analytics (PulseStream Engine).
subdomain.why_distinct: Owns the rules and lifecycle of raw telemetry (validation, reordering by device time, append-only history) within an endurance athletic analytics platform; differentiator of the platform.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Individual 1Hz data point of a sensor metric.
Raw payload received from a device carrying one or more Telemetry Samples.
Physical physiological/mechanical limit for a metric (HR 30–240 BPM, Power 0–2500W, Cadence 0–220 RPM, Swimming Pace >45 sec/100m).
Status flag tagged on a sample violating a Sensor Metric Boundary; the payload is never dropped.
Demand-driven flow control at the ingestion entry point so burst loads never block I/O threads.
Device-generated epoch timestamp; the chronological ordering key.
Arrival time at the engine; never used for ordering.
60-second window within which delayed out-of-order packets are re-indexed chronologically.
Appended record representing a correction or backfilled frame, preserving auditability.

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Validation
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Accept Ingress Packets under backpressure and validate each Telemetry Sample against Sensor Metric Boundaries before downstream propagation.
in_scope: Ingress Packet intake from edge devices, bike computers, wearables
Boundary validation for HR, Power, Cadence, Swimming Pace and tagging VALIDATION_FAILED
Metrics: heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry
invariants: Every Telemetry Sample is validated against its Sensor Metric Boundary (HR: 30–240 BPM, Power: 0–2500W, Cadence: 0–220 RPM, Swimming Pace: >45 sec/100m) before downstream propagation
Invalid samples are tagged VALIDATION_FAILED and the underlying payload is never dropped
Ingestion entry point maintains reactive backpressure with zero blocking I/O on thread pools
source_of_truth: Validation status of a Telemetry Sample

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Stream Processing & History
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Reorder delayed samples by Device Timestamp, keep the append-only raw history with revisions, buffer windowed streams and broadcast to downstream event streams.
in_scope: Re-indexing by t_device within the 60-second Backfill Reorder Window
Append-only raw record storage and Event Revisions
invariants: Out-of-order packets delayed up to 60 seconds are re-indexed chronologically by t_device, not t_ingress
Raw time-series records are strictly append-only; corrections and backfills append new Event Revisions
source_of_truth: Raw time-series history and its revisions

assumptions.item: AMBIGUITY: delivery posture of inbound flow (at-most-once vs at-least-once) and the identity distinguishing a retry from a new sample (e.g. device id + metric + t_device) are not stated; append-only history needs this to avoid duplicate revisions. Question for owner.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Dedup identity would be owned by Ingestion & Validation or by History; assumed natural identity (device, metric, t_device) owned by History pending answer.

assumptions.item: Single description subdomain split into two contexts on rule ownership (validation/flow control vs ordering/history).
Behavior for packets later than 60 seconds is unspecified; assumed handled as an Event Revision correction.
Validation boundaries for ground contact time, respiration and swim stroke are not given; left unbounded.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: None on boundaries; limits validation invariant.
